description: This file defines the ProductRepository class implementing IProductRepository, handling CRUD operations for Product entities within an Entity Framework Core context.

classes.name: ProductRepository
classes.description: Repository class for managing Product data operations using Entity Framework Core.

methods.name: GetAllAsync
methods.description: Retrieves all products asynchronously without tracking.

methods.name: GetByIdAsync
methods.description: Retrieves a product by its ID asynchronously.

methods.name: CreateAsync
methods.description: Creates a new product entry asynchronously.

methods.name: UpdateAsync
methods.description: Updates an existing product based on ID asynchronously.

methods.name: DeleteAsync
methods.description: Deletes a product by ID asynchronously.
